steps.content: 08:15 The conference hall in the center of the square

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...All this fuss, and we're back to square one. You lot are a buzzkill.
Tens of guns are aimed at Zoya, who finds herself facing a solid wall of heavy-armored soldiers and several eye-blinding cold lights.
This isn't a negotiation hall, but an execution ground.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: The Legion is attacking the square. That's solid evidence of subversion. The city council has cleared your extermination.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Your riot is over. Zoya, raise your hands!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Raise your hands and surrender yourself. Do you hear me?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Shoot me already, or shut up. Don't give me this threatening crap.
Her aura overpowers everyone present. Dead silence takes over the hall.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You haven't set foot in Syndicate for years. Why have you chosen to come back here today of all days, right when the Legion is about to eradicate all other gangs and take over Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Because you'll lose your source of income once the gangs are eradicated? Or because the Legion has come upon some secret that will choke off your career?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Let's return to the negotiation table, <color=#fb9259>Burns</color>, director of the city council, former Chief of the local security precinct.
A deep, indignant voice pipes up from behind the wall of soldiers, somewhere the light can't reach.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: This isn't a threat. There hasn't been a negotiation. This is an order. Turn over the inheritance and the Sinner.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Or you and your Legion will perish today. Your deaths will restore the authority of the West District Order Management Regulations and serve as a reminder to all Syndicans of what awaits those who rebel.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Well, well... you're like a mad dog that has got its tail stepped on and can do nothing but bark.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: If you're so concerned about getting caught, you shouldn't have hooked up with those Mania peddlers and allowed them to ruin Syndicate.
Burns' face goes even darker.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: What did that Sinner tell you?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The kid didn't discover this. I guessed it. She didn't realize that the <color=#fb9259>source</color> of a piece of information is as important as the information itself.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: This subordinate of mine learned the whereabouts of the inheritance while she was half-unconscious in captivity. She was held in the MBCC, then in the Public Security Bureau of the West District.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Drugging imprisoned Sinners is right up the alley of those timid sheriffs.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The question is, why did that particular piece of information appear in the cell... while the Legion had searched for it for so long, interrogated so many gangsters, and trashed so many black markets to no avail?

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Are you implying the Public Security Bureau is proliferating Mania weapons?!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't play dumb with me! Give me the <color=#fb9259>arms dealer</color> you've been protecting!

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: ...Shut it, you thug. You don't have a clue of what I'm trying to achieve here.
He pulls out his handgun and points it at Zoya, staring daggers at her.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: You rotten rats. You scorn education, you have no vision, you refuse to see the bigger picture. All you do is fight each other in the mire of violence, and then rot and descend along with this stinky neighborhood.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: ...Be quiet and accept your death. To think you even tried to lay a finger on me!

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: I am the man who will stand on the top of the city, who will lead it to true glory!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't make me laugh. You're a Syndican too.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Thirteen years ago, you signed the <color=#fb9259>West District Order Management Regulations</color>; by betraying Syndicate to make a fortune and cultivate connections, you got yourself out of Syndicate and into the Public Security Bureau, and eventually got to where you are today.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You're flaunting your new identity, and at the same time, you're eager to cut yourself off from your past. Looks like you want to be a pure dignitary?

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Shut it!
He opens fire, and a few dozen gangsters rush forwards and fire their ridiculously heavy-duty guns at Zoya in rapid succession, the Mania Crystals in the weapons glowing a dazzling red.
She doesn't attempt to dodge the gunfire. In anger, she's produced around herself a powerful field that keeps the gunfire from reaching her.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: See? You despise the violence of Syndicate. But when you come face to face with it, all you do is bluster from a safe distance.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: If it weren't for these filthy weapons, you wouldn't even dare breathe loudly in front of me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You can't wipe your slate clean, Burns. No matter how degenerate the Syndicans might become, you will be the most hideous of them all!
Every firearm, be it the standard-issue gun of the sheriffs or the Mania weapon of the gangsters, is pointed at the only outcast in the hall. Undeterred, Zoya strides on.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: To be honest, I did hold a glimmer of hope that there would be more of those simple-minded straight-shooters, so that the stinky script wouldn't be followed again.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Sure enough, there can only be one possible ending for this city in the hands of people like you.
She throws a heavy pouch downwards, cracking the solid concrete floor instantly and sending the nearest circle of mixed soldiers up into the air.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I hear people who have nothing to do with this or do not follow orders are not allowed in.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: So it means these are all your people? Great...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Then I won't feel bad for killing any of you!
